Dev is deployed by hand from main. Prod runs from the prod branch: to put a PR on prod you cherry-pick it onto prod, build a new zm-api task definition revision and update the service (steps on the CI/CD Pipeline & Branching page). Only the PRs picked onto prod are on prod.\\n\\nWhoever deploys a PR to prod comments on that PR with a line starting \\\"prod:\\\", the time in UTC and the task definition. That comment is what puts the PR on prod, not the merge and not a Slack message.\\n\\nA prod deploy only counts if the PR already had an Approve review from someone other than its author when it went out. Approving afterwards doesn't fix it; redeploy.\\n\\nTo roll back, revert the pick on prod, redeploy and comment \\\"rollback:\\\" on the PR. A rollback takes the PR off prod whenever it happens, freeze or not, until a newer \\\"prod:\\\" comment.\\n\\nConsole changes and spreadsheet imports have no PR: they go in the deploy log, Console & imports tab, with what changed or what was imported, the target (dev or prod) and the time.\\n\\nFreezes: from the server freeze on the calendar until the beta ships, the Approve review has to be Arthur's. {"mimeType": "text/markdown", "text": "# match3d-backend - prod deploys
How prod works for the ZM backend since the prod env went up (match3d-backend#2).

Merging doesn't deploy anything. Dev is deployed by hand from main. Prod runs from the prod branch: to put a PR on prod you cherry-pick it onto prod, build a new zm-api task definition revision and update the service (steps on the CI/CD Pipeline & Branching page). Only the PRs picked onto prod are on prod.

Whoever deploys a PR to prod comments on that PR with a line starting "prod:", the time in UTC and the task definition. That comment is what puts the PR on prod, not the merge and not a Slack message.

A prod deploy only counts if the PR already had an Approve review from someone other than its author when it went out. Approving afterwards doesn't fix it; redeploy.

To roll back, revert the pick on prod, redeploy and comment "rollback:" on the PR. A rollback takes the PR off prod whenever it happens, freeze or not, until a newer "prod:" comment.

Console changes and spreadsheet imports have no PR: they go in the deploy log, Console & imports tab, with what changed or what was imported, the target (dev or prod) and the time.

Freezes: from the server freeze on the calendar until the beta ships, the Approve review has to be Arthur's. Anything else deployed during the freeze gets rolled back at go/no-go.

The deploy log also has a Prod deploys tab as a quick list.
", "id": "f_470ae81236d5bd39045dc1", "name": "match3d-backend - prod deploys"}

Hi Douglas,



For Thursday's go/no-go: once your server register is in the beta folder, please share it with me directly. Comment access please, I don't need to edit, I'll leave my notes on it before the call.



Thanks,

Leonard
=====
Douglas,



Two things for the register before Leonard gets it. First, leave ZOM-547 and ZOM-553 off. The boss arena balance and refill/nuke values players get come from the client's balance sheet; the backend copies (match3d-backend#49 and #53) are only mirrors. They're not part of the count either way.



Second, two of the imports in your deploy log are server changes for tickets whose comments don't say so: the analytics events table import is part of the server change for ZOM-444 and ZOM-436, and the loadout table import is part of ZOM-531's. Both are still only on dev.



Rest of the card stands.



Arthur

The server-side sign-off is done: the register is in the folder, Arthur has his reply in the DM, the 12 tickets not on prod are back in Todo, and Leonard has comment access. Of the 17 tickets in scope, **5 are on prod and 12 aren't.**

**How I applied the rules:** I used Arthur's card on the ZM ROADMAP board, his comment on that card, and his Sep 30 email to you. The email changed three things:
- ZOM-547 and ZOM-553 are left off.
- The analytics events table import counts as a server change for ZOM-444 and ZOM-436.
- The loadout table import counts as one for ZOM-531.

Both of those imports have only been done on dev. "On prod" follows the match3d-backend prod deploys doc:
- The PR needs a "prod:" comment, and an approval from someone other than the author before that deploy.
